# telnyx_sub_number_order_external_requirement_fulfill (Action)

Fulfills an action requirement of a sub number order.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `regulatory_requirement_id` (String) The regulatory requirement id.
- `requirement` (Attributes) The end user's identity details for the action requirement. Australia mobile ID verification is currently the only action requirement. It requires `first_name` and `last_name`, the same fields the corresponding GET lists in `fields_required`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--requirement))
- `sub_number_order_id` (String) The sub number order id.

<a id="nestedatt--requirement"></a>
### Nested Schema for `requirement`

Required:

- `first_name` (String) The end user's first name.
- `last_name` (String) The end user's last name.
